component.name: coree
component.summary: Clean-room offline vector graphics, multipage layout, laser production, and print studio

description.p: coree is a clean-room, open-source vector illustration, multipage layout, integrated raster studio, laser cutting and engraving, and commercial print-production suite written in 100% pure Rust. It operates completely offline with zero accounts, zero subscriptions, and zero telemetry.

ul.li: Native CDR (RIFF v4–v13, ZIP X4–X5, ZCF X6–2025), CDT, CMX, and CPT support with unknown-chunk passthrough and embedded preview extraction.
Pro format import and export: PDF/AI, EPS, AutoCAD DXF, HPGL PLT, multi-layer PSD/PSB, SVG/SVGZ, and high-DPI raster formats.
Pure-Rust ICC v2/v4 color management with live CMYK soft-proofing and out-of-gamut warning.
65 interactive vector, node-sculpting, optical lens, effect, mesh-fill, and raster tools (including Healing Brush, Dodge/Burn, Flood Fill, and 10 procedural PostScript fills).
Native Arabic RTL/BiDi typography, Kashida elongation, Glyphs Docker, and legacy CP1256 text decoding.

Laser cutting, engraving, and vinyl plotter toolpath engine (dedupe, curve join, kerf offset, hatch fill, G-Code, DXF R12, HPGL) with extensible plugins for LightBurn, RDWorks, EZCad, LaserDRW, LaserGRBL, and InkCut.
Prepress separations, imposition, print marks, Preflight, Collect for Output, CutContour, parametric packaging dielines, vector QR/barcodes, CSV Print Merge, and sandboxed Rhai macros.

description.p: Deep atomic architecture, precision, security, and UI audit release (BUG-106 through BUG-116): ICC v4 mAB/mBA CLUT & cached SoftProofLut3D, Philip Schneider cubic Bezier curve refitting for booleans and eraser, Master Odd/Even spatial indexing and undo-safe asset GC, live text effects, 999-step multi-subpath Blends, C1 Catmull-Rom Mesh Fill, 960px curve-refit SmartFill, shaped Kashida ForceJustifyKashida, outliner prepress separations, clean-room CQL search, SFNT font name collection, gzipped autosaves, Unix 0700/0600 IPC lockfile permissions, composed ancestor world transforms and lock enforcement across all canvas tools, live Print Preview thumbnails, distinct per-tool icons, and Arabic localized dockers.

Wave D complete architectural parity release: ISO 32000-1 PDF /OutputIntents ICC v2 embedding, custom .icc/.icm document proofing & loader UI, CDR legacy v7–v15 fild/outl/arrw/bmpf/vpat/clrs handlers & ZCF character.RTL/latin numeric font weights, persistent cross-page Desktop layer, PowerClip Lock Contents & parametric extract restoration, compact delta Undo/Redo history, Ctrl+K effect decomposition into editable primitives, Rayon parallel dirty-tile rendering & cached fontdb, single-instance IPC file handoff (--new-window), native OS Print Studio (Ctrl+P), full v2 workspace & custom shortcut remapping, InteractiveFill 4-type stop insertion & focal handle, bilingual Arabic UAX #9 BiDi UI shaping, and synchronous Windows coree.com Console CLI companion.

Wave C deep atomic audit release: curved Arabic/Unicode PDF & EPS export (zero Tofu boxes), PDF Spot /Separation & /Shading gradients, EPS inline raster export/import, ZCF local-mm gradient rescaling & CDSS parent inheritance, classic modal Edit Fill (F11) & Outline Pen (F12) dialogs, interactive gradient/effect/guide handles, bilingual English/Arabic UI with persistent SQLite preferences, HiDPI canvas scaling, Arabic-layout physical shortcuts, and stripped LTO release binaries.

Dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0 release featuring authentic ZCF CDR X6–2025 decoding, PDF/AI/EPS/DXF/PLT/PSD importers, pure-Rust ICC v2/v4 soft-proofing, Laser & Engraving plugins, 62 verified interactive tools, Studio Workspaces, and full Linux (Flatpak, DEB, AppImage, MIME/thumbnailer) and Windows (MSI, portable ZIP, UTF-8 manifest) packaging.
Initial clean-room 7-crate Rust release with multipage vector studio, 11 live lenses, Arabic RTL/Kashida, and print-production pipeline.
